currentModel: Personal knowledge palace organized into rooms and stations representing real-world information, media, projects, people, and memory systems.

protocols.githubConnectorAvoidance: Use manual file generation and GitHub Desktop / VS Code instead of relying on the slow GitHub connector.
protocols.publishedSaveRule: Do not overwrite published GitHub history. Save into the next version folder.
protocols.highestVersionLoadRule: When loading from GitHub folders, identify and use the highest numbered version folder.
protocols.targetedFileRule: Individual files may be regenerated when their area/version/purpose is clear from the filename.
